effortNote: Estimated planning scenario: 120 engineer-hours reduced to 36. This is sample data, not time tracked on an uploaded project.

findings.title: Collapse N+1 order queries
findings.whySlow: Loading each order’s items lazily adds a database round trip per order.
findings.fix: Use a bounded fetch join or an entity graph for this access pattern; verify pagination and query plans.
findings.expectedGain: Potentially replace many database round trips with a bounded query count.

findings.title: Index the hot lookup path
findings.whySlow: Filtering orders by customer and creation time can scan the full table.
findings.fix: Inspect EXPLAIN ANALYZE; add a composite index aligned with predicates and sort order.
findings.expectedGain: Lower read latency when selectivity is sufficient; inserts may become more expensive.

findings.title: Bound blocking outbound I/O
findings.whySlow: A slow upstream occupies request threads without a bounded wait.
findings.fix: Set connect/read deadlines and use nonblocking WebClient end to end where appropriate. Keep JDBC off event loops.
findings.expectedGain: More concurrent in-flight requests under slow upstream responses.

findings.title: Run independent requests concurrently
findings.whySlow: Independent inventory and shipping lookups run sequentially.
findings.fix: Combine them with CompletableFuture on a bounded executor, or a reactive zip; propagate timeouts and cancellation.
findings.expectedGain: Wall time may approach the slowest independent call instead of their sum.

findings.title: Right-size HikariCP connections
findings.whySlow: Opening new connections and an unbounded queue amplify tail latency.
findings.fix: Reuse HikariCP connections; set pool size and acquisition timeout against the database connection budget.
findings.expectedGain: Reduce connection setup overhead without overwhelming the database.

findings.title: Cache stable catalogue reads
findings.whySlow: Unchanged product data is fetched repeatedly for every request.
findings.fix: Cache stable reads with a bounded Caffeine cache or shared Redis; define TTL and invalidation explicitly.
findings.expectedGain: Fewer repeat database reads while the cache is warm.

findings.title: Load only the fields a request needs
findings.whySlow: Full entities hydrate unused columns and relationships.
findings.fix: Use a DTO projection for read-only endpoints and verify that required fields and ordering are preserved.
findings.expectedGain: Lower allocation, database transfer and serialization cost.

findings.title: Batch large inserts
findings.whySlow: One insert and flush per row creates excessive network round trips.
findings.fix: Use bounded JDBC batches with transaction boundaries, failure handling and an identifier strategy that supports batching.
findings.expectedGain: Higher import throughput; the batch size must be load-tested.

findings.title: Trim and compress response payloads
findings.whySlow: The endpoint serializes unused properties into large uncompressed responses.
findings.fix: Return a bounded DTO page and enable compression above a size threshold; measure CPU versus transfer cost.
findings.expectedGain: Fewer bytes transferred on slower networks.

findings.title: Tune the JVM within container limits
findings.whySlow: Heap settings leave insufficient headroom for native memory and CPU throttling.
findings.fix: Set explicit requests/limits, retain native-memory headroom, inspect GC pauses and tune with representative traffic.
findings.expectedGain: More predictable tail latency and fewer memory-pressure restarts.

artifacts.name: Dockerfile
artifacts.content:
# Integration example for the full modernized Spring Boot service.
# The demo ZIP contains excerpts, not the executable service JAR.
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY target/orders.jar /app/app.jar
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=65", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]

artifacts.name: Kubernetes manifests
artifacts.content:
# Review image, resources and probes before applying to your cluster.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: orders
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
      containers:
        - name: orders
          image: orders:modernized
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/readiness
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: orders
spec:
  selector:
    app: orders
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

artifacts.name: CI/CD pipeline
artifacts.content:
# Integration example; install in .github/workflows after configuring the full service.
name: Verify and package
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
          cache: maven
      - name: Run unit, integration and parity tests
        run: mvn -B verify
      - name: Package container after verification
        run: docker build -t orders:modernized .
